svg.text: What matched at one loop: the share of gravity's stiffness 1/G that is induced
RG time t = ln k (energy grows to the right)
One loop = Sakharov: 1/G = 1/G0 + w k^2. R/(1-R) = G0 w k^2,
so the odds grow by e^2 per e-fold (a union / odds rule, ours).
Beyond one loop the graviton's own loops make the rate drift:
the odds rule breaks by 1/22 at the fixed-point end.
